# ElectricMorphogenesis provenance

Upstream: https://github.com/santamanicka/ElectricMorphogenesis
Paper: Manicka, S. & Levin, M. (2025), *Field-mediated bioelectric basis of morphogenetic prepatterning*.

MathArtist does **not** vendor or copy the upstream Python implementation. `tools/generate_trajectories.py`
is an independent NumPy implementation of the equations and default parameter values documented by the
upstream source. The trained clamp/model pickle is intentionally not bundled. Therefore the source is
labeled `EXACT-EQUATIONS`, not `EXACT-RUNTIME` or a reproduction of a trained figure.

The repository's LICENSE file is CC BY 4.0 at the inspected revision; attribution is retained here.
